user.title: Quarter Hour Power
user.description: Select a cumulative grid-import energy sensor. The house-consumption energy sensor is optional; without it only grid 15-minute power and the monthly grid peak are calculated. An optional prefix is prepended to the names of all entities created by this integration.

error.entity_not_found: The selected entity was not found.
error.invalid_energy_unit: Select a sensor using Wh, kWh or MWh.
error.invalid_state_class: Select a cumulative sensor with state class total or total_increasing.

init.title: Quarter Hour Power options
init.description: Change the grid source, optional house source and entity-name prefix. Without a house source, house, reduction and reduction-percentage calculations are disabled. Changing a source keeps applicable monthly peaks, discards the current interval baseline, and starts a fresh baseline at the next quarter-hour boundary.
